C1-1-0.name: Say it with a phrasal verb
C1-1-0.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con el phrasal verb adecuado, cuidando la posición de la partícula.
items: I can’t stand his attitude any more. (tolerate) → I can’t ______ his attitude any more.
We argued about money and stopped speaking. (quarrel) → We ______ over money.
The meeting has been postponed until Friday. → They’ve ______ the meeting until Friday.
She raised the issue of salaries at the meeting. → She ______ the issue of salaries.
Turn off the lights. (use a pronoun) → Turn ______.
I’ve always admired my grandmother. → I’ve always ______ my grandmother.
answers: I can’t put up with his attitude any more.
We fell out over money.
They’ve put off the meeting until Friday.
She brought up the issue of salaries.
Turn them off.
I’ve always looked up to my grandmother.

C1-1-1.name: Gerund or infinitive?
C1-1-1.prompt: Completa cada frase con la forma correcta (-ing o to + verbo) según el significado.
items: She didn’t lock the door. She forgot. → She forgot ______ (lock) the door.
I have a clear memory of meeting him in 2019. → I remember ______ (meet) him in 2019.
He paused on the way to buy coffee. → He stopped ______ (buy) coffee.
If the app freezes, restart your phone as an experiment. → Try ______ (restart) your phone.
We said no to the offer. → We refused ______ (accept) the offer.
I’m sorry I said that. → I regret ______ (say) that.
answers: She forgot to lock the door.
I remember meeting him in 2019.
He stopped to buy coffee.
Try restarting your phone.
We refused to accept the offer.
I regret saying that.

C1-2-0.name: Object + which verb form?
C1-2-0.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con el verbo indicado y el patrón correcto: objeto + to, verbo base o -ing.
items: My boss said I had to stay late. (make) → My boss ______ late.
They allowed us to use the terrace. (let) → They ______ the terrace.
I’d like you to read the contract first. (want) → I ______ the contract first.
I noticed her. She was crossing the street. (see) → I ______ the street.
They forced him to sign. (passive) → He ______ sign.
We weren’t permitted to take photos. (allowed) → We ______ photos.
answers: My boss made me stay late.
They let us use the terrace.
I want you to read the contract first.
I saw her crossing the street.
He was made to sign.
We weren’t allowed to take photos.

C1-2-1.name: Spotlight it
C1-2-1.prompt: Reescribe cada frase como una frase hendida con what (o all) para destacar la idea clave.
items: The colour caught my eye. → What ______
We need more time. → What ______
She rewrote the entire report. (focus on the action) → What she ______
I only want an apology. (all) → All ______
Her honesty surprised me. → What ______
They cancelled the event. (focus on the action) → What they ______
answers: What caught my eye was the colour.
What we need is more time.
What she did was rewrite the entire report.
All I want is an apology.
What surprised me was her honesty.
What they did was cancel the event.

C1-3-0.name: Article or no article?
C1-3-0.prompt: Completa cada espacio con a, an, the o ningún artículo (—).
items: ___ internet has changed ___ way we work.
She’s studying at ___ university in Manizales. ___ university is famous for engineering.
___ robots are becoming cheaper every year.
It was ___ first time I had seen ___ MRI scan.
He’s ___ only person who understands ___ problem.
___ education is ___ key to reducing inequality.
answers: The internet has changed the way we work.
She’s studying at a university in Manizales. The university is famous for engineering.
Robots are becoming cheaper every year. (no article)
It was the first time I had seen an MRI scan.
He’s the only person who understands the problem.
Education is the key to reducing inequality. (no article before “Education”)

C1-3-1.name: Compress it
C1-3-1.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con una cláusula -ing (o having + participio), manteniendo el mismo sujeto.
items: Because she didn’t know the way, she asked a police officer.
When he opened the envelope, he found a cheque.
After they had finished the survey, they analysed the data.
The report, which shows a clear trend, surprised everyone.
As I was feeling ill, I stayed at home.
She smiled and waved goodbye. (one sentence with an -ing clause)
answers: Not knowing the way, she asked a police officer.
Opening the envelope, he found a cheque.
Having finished the survey, they analysed the data.
The report, showing a clear trend, surprised everyone.
Feeling ill, I stayed at home.
Smiling, she waved goodbye.

C1-4-0.name: Report it
C1-4-0.prompt: Pasa cada frase a estilo indirecto con el verbo indicado, cambiando tiempos, pronombres y expresiones de tiempo.
items: “I will call you tomorrow,” she said. → She said ______
“I broke the vase,” he admitted. → He admitted ______
“I can’t come to the party,” Ana told me. → Ana told me ______
“We’re moving to Cali next month,” they said. → They said ______
“I didn’t take the money,” he said. (deny) → He denied ______
“Don’t walk under that ladder,” my grandmother said. (warn) → My grandmother warned me ______
answers: She said (that) she would call me the next day.
He admitted (that) he had broken the vase.
Ana told me (that) she couldn’t come to the party.
They said (that) they were moving to Cali the following month.
He denied taking the money. / He denied that he had taken the money.
My grandmother warned me not to walk under that ladder.

C1-4-1.name: Remove the source
C1-4-1.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con una pasiva impersonal, empezando con las palabras dadas.
items: People say that the castle is haunted. → The castle ______
People believe that he lives in Panama. → It ______
Experts think that the painting was stolen in 1990. → The painting ______
Reports say that the minister has resigned. → The minister ______
People claim that the ritual protects the house. → It ______
Everyone knows that the company is losing money. → The company ______
answers: The castle is said to be haunted.
It is believed that he lives in Panama.
The painting is thought to have been stolen in 1990.
The minister is reported to have resigned.
It is claimed that the ritual protects the house.
The company is known to be losing money.

C1-5-0.name: Comment on it
C1-5-0.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con un adverbio de oración que exprese la misma actitud.
items: It was a surprise that the low-budget film won. → ______, the low-budget film won.
I’m being honest: the ending disappointed me. → ______, the ending disappointed me.
People say they are filming a sequel. → ______, they are filming a sequel.
It’s a pity the concert was cancelled. → ______, the concert was cancelled.
I assume the director wanted a darker tone. → ______, the director wanted a darker tone.
It was lucky that nobody was injured. → ______, nobody was injured.
answers: Surprisingly, the low-budget film won.
Frankly, the ending disappointed me.
Apparently, they are filming a sequel.
Unfortunately, the concert was cancelled.
Presumably, the director wanted a darker tone.
Luckily, nobody was injured.

C1-5-1.name: Degree and result
C1-5-1.prompt: Une las dos ideas con so…that o such…that, usando la palabra indicada.
items: The film was long. I fell asleep. (such) → It was ______
The plot was confusing. Nobody understood it. (so) → The plot was ______
There were a lot of twists. I lost track. (so many) → There were ______
She acted convincingly. She won an award. (so) → She acted ______
They were good actors. Everyone cried. (such) → They were ______
The ending was shocking. The audience gasped. (formal inversion) → So ______
answers: It was such a long film that I fell asleep.
The plot was so confusing that nobody understood it.
There were so many twists that I lost track.
She acted so convincingly that she won an award.
They were such good actors that everyone cried.
So shocking was the ending that the audience gasped.

C1-6-0.name: The more…, the more…
C1-6-0.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con un doble comparativo (o con “more and more”).
items: If you practise more, you play better. → The more ______
As the crowd gets louder, the band gets happier. → The louder ______
When the song is harder, it’s more rewarding. → The harder ______
As I get older, I worry less. → The older ______
If we leave early, it will be better. (short form) → The ______
Tickets keep getting more expensive. (more and more) → Tickets are getting ______
answers: The more you practise, the better you play.
The louder the crowd, the happier the band.
The harder the song, the more rewarding it is.
The older I get, the less I worry.
The sooner, the better.
Tickets are getting more and more expensive.

C1-6-1.name: Habits with will and would
C1-6-1.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con will, would o used to según el tipo de hábito indicado.
items: My brother always leaves his shoes in the hall. (typical present habit) → My brother ______
Every summer we went to my grandparents’ farm. (past habit) → Every summer we ______
I loved that band when I was a teenager. (past state) → I ______
She keeps interrupting me, and it annoys me! (irritation) → She ______!
As a child, I hummed along to every song. (past habit) → As a child, I ______
Babies usually sleep for most of the day. (general truth) → Babies ______
answers: My brother will leave his shoes in the hall.
Every summer we would go to my grandparents’ farm.
I used to love that band when I was a teenager.
She WILL keep interrupting me!
As a child, I would hum along to every song.
Babies will sleep for most of the day.

C1-7-0.name: Keep it or drop it
C1-7-0.prompt: Decide si puedes omitir el pronombre relativo y reescribe la frase; en las dos últimas, une las ideas como se indica.
items: The film that we watched last night was awful. (Can you omit the pronoun?)
The woman who lives upstairs is a doctor. (Can you omit the pronoun?)
Everything that he told me was a lie. (Can you omit the pronoun?)
The family whose car was stolen called the police. (Can you omit the pronoun?)
This is the café. We met in it. (Join informally, without a pronoun.)
This is the café. We met in it. (Join formally.)
answers: The film we watched last night was awful. (Yes: “that” is the object.)
The woman who lives upstairs is a doctor. (No: “who” is the subject.)
Everything he told me was a lie. (Yes: “that” is the object.)
The family whose car was stolen called the police. (No: “whose” is never omitted.)
This is the café we met in.
This is the café in which we met.

C1-7-1.name: As if or the way?
C1-7-1.prompt: Completa cada frase con as if / as though, the way, like o as, cuidando el tiempo verbal.
items: He isn’t the boss, but he gives orders. → He gives orders as if ______
It seems that the meeting has been cancelled. → It looks as though ______
Cook the rice exactly as your grandmother did. → Cook the rice the way ______
She isn’t my mother, but she talks to me like that. → She talks to me as though ______
He sings beautifully, like a professional. (like + noun) → He sings ______
We discussed this earlier: the price has gone up. (formal as) → As ______
answers: He gives orders as if he were the boss.
It looks as though the meeting has been cancelled.
Cook the rice the way your grandmother did.
She talks to me as though she were my mother.
He sings like a professional.
As we discussed earlier, the price has gone up.

C1-8-0.name: Who gets what?
C1-8-0.prompt: Reordena los objetos o corrige el error según la instrucción de cada frase.
items: The clerk gave a refund to me. (Put the person first.)
She showed her colleagues the report. (Put the thing first.)
Explain me the problem. (Correct the error.)
I bought my mother flowers. (Use a preposition.)
Send her it. (Make it more natural.)
Could you describe me the house? (Correct the error.)
answers: The clerk gave me a refund.
She showed the report to her colleagues.
Explain the problem to me.
I bought flowers for my mother.
Send it to her.
Could you describe the house to me?

C1-8-1.name: Base form after that
C1-8-1.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con el subjuntivo (verbo base) después de that, o con -ing donde se indica.
items: “You must refund the customer,” the manager said. → The manager insisted that ______
Every receipt must be kept. → It is essential that ______
“Try a smaller size,” we told her. → We recommended that ______
He mustn’t be charged. → We insist that ______
“Arrive early,” the guide advised us. → The guide suggested that ______
She should apply before May. (use -ing) → We recommend ______
answers: The manager insisted that the customer be refunded.
It is essential that every receipt be kept.
We recommended that she try a smaller size.
We insist that he not be charged.
The guide suggested that we arrive early.
We recommend applying before May.

C1-9-0.name: Specific or any?
C1-9-0.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con when, where, whenever o wherever según el significado.
items: No matter where you go in this city, you’ll find street art. → ______
Every time it rains, the road floods. → ______
This is the village. My grandmother was born there. (where / wherever?) → ______
Sit in any seat you like. → ______
Call me at any time you need help. → ______
I’ll phone you at the moment I land. (when / whenever?) → ______
answers: Wherever you go in this city, you’ll find street art.
Whenever it rains, the road floods.
This is the village where my grandmother was born.
Sit wherever you like.
Call me whenever you need help.
I’ll phone you when I land.

C1-9-1.name: Whoever, whatever, whichever
C1-9-1.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con whoever, whatever o whichever.
items: Any person who breaks the rules will be fined. → ______
You can eat anything that you want. → ______
The person who took my umbrella should return it. → ______
Choose the option that suits you best: A or B. → ______
It doesn’t matter what happens; don’t lose hope. → ______
We’ll support any candidate who protects the reserve. → ______
answers: Whoever breaks the rules will be fined.
You can eat whatever you want.
Whoever took my umbrella should return it.
Choose whichever option suits you best.
Whatever happens, don’t lose hope.
We’ll support whoever protects the reserve.

C1-10-0.name: Make it passive
C1-10-0.prompt: Reescribe cada frase en pasiva (o en causativa), empezando con las palabras dadas.
items: They speak over 60 languages in Colombia. → Over 60 languages ______
Someone stole my bike last night. → My bike ______
They have published the results. → The results ______
They will translate the book into French. → The book ______
Someone must sign the form. → The form ______
A tutor checked my essay. (causative) → I had ______
answers: Over 60 languages are spoken in Colombia.
My bike was stolen last night.
The results have been published.
The book will be translated into French.
The form must be signed.
I had my essay checked by a tutor.

C1-10-1.name: Singular or plural?
C1-10-1.prompt: Completa cada frase con la forma correcta del verbo entre paréntesis.
items: Most of the students ___ (be) late yesterday.
Each of the answers ___ (be) correct.
A number of problems ___ (have) been reported.
The number of tourists ___ (grow) every year.
None of the information ___ (be) useful.
Half of the cake ___ (be) eaten before the party started.
answers: Most of the students were late yesterday.
Each of the answers is correct.
A number of problems have been reported.
The number of tourists grows every year.
None of the information was useful.
Half of the cake was eaten before the party started.

C1-11-0.name: Compress the description
C1-11-0.prompt: Convierte cada descripción en un adjetivo compuesto delante del sustantivo.
items: a plan that lasts five years → a ______ plan
a report with ten pages → a ______ report
a student who works hard → a ______ student
an athlete who is famous all over the world → a ______ athlete
a drink that contains no sugar → a ______ drink
an expert who is highly respected → a ______ expert
answers: a five-year plan
a ten-page report
a hard-working student
a world-famous athlete
a sugar-free drink
a highly respected expert (no hyphen after an -ly adverb)

C1-11-1.name: Make it superlative
C1-11-1.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con un adjetivo compuesto en comparativo o superlativo.
items: She is a well-known writer. (superlative, of her generation) → She is ______
He works harder than anyone else on the team. → He is ______
This award is respected more widely than any other. → This is ______
This lab has better equipment than any other in the country. → This is ______
Nobody is paid worse than cleaners in this company. → Cleaners are ______
This writer is known better than that one. (comparative) → This writer is ______
answers: She is the best-known writer of her generation.
He is the hardest-working person on the team.
This is the most widely respected award.
This is the best-equipped lab in the country.
Cleaners are the worst-paid workers in this company.
This writer is better known than that one.

C1-12-0.name: Drop the if
C1-12-0.prompt: Reescribe cada condicional con inversión (were, had o should) y sin if.
items: If I were in charge, I would cut costs. → Were ______
If we had known about the strike, we would have changed the date. → Had ______
If you need any further information, please contact us. → Should ______
If they hadn’t signed the contract, we would have lost the client. → Had ______
If the company were to close, hundreds would lose their jobs. → Were ______
If the parcel doesn’t arrive by Monday, please call us. → Should ______
answers: Were I in charge, I would cut costs.
Had we known about the strike, we would have changed the date.
Should you need any further information, please contact us.
Had they not signed the contract, we would have lost the client.
Were the company to close, hundreds would lose their jobs.
Should the parcel not arrive by Monday, please call us.

C1-12-1.name: Set the condition
C1-12-1.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con el conector de condición indicado.
items: You can borrow my car, but only if you return it by six. (as long as) → ______
We’ll cancel the trip if the weather doesn’t improve. (unless) → ______
Take some cash. You might need to pay for parking. (in case) → ______
The bonus is yours, but only if you reach the target. (provided that) → ______
If you don’t book now, there won’t be any seats. (unless) → ______
Write down my number. You might get lost. (in case) → ______
answers: You can borrow my car as long as you return it by six.
We’ll cancel the trip unless the weather improves.
Take some cash in case you need to pay for parking.
The bonus is yours provided that you reach the target.
Unless you book now, there won’t be any seats.
Write down my number in case you get lost.
